turns.content: Let w=sqrt(5)i. If -142+333w=(a+bw)(c+dw), expand the product and equate real and w coefficients. What two Diophantine equations result?
For N(x+yw)=x^2+5y^2, compute N(-142+333w) and factor the result into primes.
Use unique prime factorization of elements in Z[w] as the sole method for enumerating factor pairs from the prime factorization of the norm.
Divide -142+333w by a+bw and derive explicit formulas for c and d in terms of a and b and N(a+bw).
For each candidate norm, determine the positive pairs (a,b), then apply the quotient formulas to test whether c and d are also positive integers.

One listed factorization uses (a,b)=(24,1) but gives a complementary factor with a negative real coefficient. Explain why that case fails the all-positive requirement and identify the admissible positive-coefficient factorization.
For the admissible factorization, compare a+b with c+d and report the lesser value.
